Shipping & Delivery

Last updated: 29 October 2026

On this page

We deliver VK Sports orders to addresses across India. This page explains how long things take and what delivery costs.

Dispatch times

  • Ready-stock items: usually dispatched within 1–2 working days of payment confirmation.
  • Personalised items (names / numbers on stock jerseys): usually 3–5 working days.
  • Fully custom team orders: we confirm a production date when you approve the design mockup. Tell us about tournament deadlines early.

Working days are Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays. Orders confirmed after 5 PM are processed the next working day.

Delivery times

DestinationTypical time after dispatch
Within Maharashtra2–4 working days
Metro cities3–5 working days
Rest of India4–7 working days
North-East, J&K and remote areas7–10 working days

These are estimates from our courier partners. Weather, festivals or local restrictions can occasionally cause delays.

Delivery charges

Delivery charges depend on your pincode, parcel weight and order size. We'll tell you the exact amount on WhatsApp before you pay — there are no surprise fees. Larger team orders may qualify for free delivery; ask when you request a quote.

Tracking your order

Once your parcel is handed to the courier, we'll send you the tracking number and link on WhatsApp. If tracking hasn't updated for more than 3 days, message us and we'll follow up with the courier.

Address & delivery attempts

  • Please share a complete address with pincode, landmark and a reachable phone number.
  • The courier will usually attempt delivery up to two times. If a parcel is returned because of an incorrect address or no one being available, re-shipping charges may apply.
  • Check that the package is sealed when you receive it. If it looks tampered with or damaged, please take photos and contact us within 48 hours.

Local pickup

Customers in and around Parbhani can collect orders in person. Message us on WhatsApp to arrange a pickup time.

Questions

For anything about your delivery, message us on WhatsApp or contact us. See also our Returns & Refunds policy.
